question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane plants in operation in the United States, with location, production capacity, feedstock, operator and whether they inject into the gas grid?

answer.summary: No single national plant-level list was obtained. Best structured sources: EPA LMOP (110 operating landfill-gas RNG projects, 101 pipeline injection, exact landfill coordinates, Sept 2024), EPA AgSTAR (400 operating livestock digesters, 56 listing pipeline gas, June 2024) and EPA's Part 80 registry (502 registered biogas-producer facilities with address; registration is not operation). No source publishes RNG output capacity; wastewater and food-waste plants lack plant-level data; Argonne's RNG list blocks automated access.
main_caveats: LMOP is dated September 2024 and AgSTAR June 2024; both say they are not exhaustive. Status can lag: AgSTAR still lists Rosendale RNG as under construction.
Capacity is not published as RNG output: LMOP gives landfill-gas input and AgSTAR raw biogas estimates; neither is upgrading-plant capacity.
Digester, upgrading plant and injection point can be different places (Rosendale: farm digester, upgrader at Pickett WI, injection at DTE's Newton terminal).
AgSTAR map points are approximated from city and state; LMOP coordinates are the landfill's, not the RNG plant's.
CARB and Oregon lists certify pathways and EPA Part 80 lists registrations, not operating plants; wastewater and food-waste plants have no capacity or feedstock source here.
answer.confidence_reason: Counts and fields come from downloaded files and two case checks; the files are 2024 editions and wastewater/food-waste plants and the Argonne list were not checked.

attributes.note: Landfill RNG: exact landfill lat/long (LMOP). Farm digesters: city/county (AgSTAR; map points approximated). Part 80 gives street addresses of 502 registered biogas facilities.
attributes.gap_note: Registered facilities are not proven operating; wastewater and food-waste plants appear only in the Part 80 registry, and the Argonne RNG database (probably the widest list) blocks automated access.

attributes.note: No RNG output capacity found. LMOP gives landfill-gas input (mmscfd, 88 of 110 rows); AgSTAR gives raw biogas cu ft/day (170 of 400 rows).
attributes.gap_note: The checked sources publish no upgrading or biomethane output capacity; wastewater, food-waste digesters and the blocked Argonne database remain unchecked.

attributes.note: AgSTAR: animal type and co-digestion on farm digesters; CARB text names feedstock per facility; LMOP rows are landfill gas by definition.
attributes.gap_note: Wastewater sludge and food-waste plants are only visible as CARB pathway rows (10 and 1 pathways); no plant-level feedstock source was checked for them.

attributes.note: LMOP aggregated file lists owners, developers, end users; AgSTAR developers/designers; Part 80 and CARB name the registered company or producer. Operator proper is rarely stated.
attributes.gap_note: No source labels the operating company as such; wastewater and food-waste plants unchecked and Argonne's list blocked.

attributes.note: LMOP flags Pipeline Injection (101) vs Local Use (9); AgSTAR 'Pipeline Gas' on 56 operating rows; CARB/Oregon text gives routes. Actual injection not confirmed.
attributes.gap_note: Injection was not confirmed against utility or interconnection records; the Rosendale check shows injection can occur at a terminal away from the farm.

sources.name: LMOP Landfill and Landfill Gas Energy Project Database (landfill- and project-level file, with project-only files)
sources.publisher: U.S. EPA, Landfill Methane Outreach Program (LMOP)
sources.format: XLSX (Excel; sheets Summary, LMOP Database, Field Descriptions)
sources.summary: 110 operational landfill-gas RNG projects (101 pipeline injection, 9 local use) with exact landfill coordinates, owners/developers/end users and start dates.
sources.coverage_note: MSW landfills only; September 2024 edition; flow is landfill gas input, not RNG output.
caveats: Not every landfill is included; coordinates are the landfill's.
No RNG capacity field; 88 of 110 rows give LFG input flow.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o lmopdata.xlsx https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2024-09/lmopdata.xlsx ; read sheet 'LMOP Database' (header in row 1) and keep rows with 'Project Type Category' == 'Renewable Natural Gas' and 'Current Project Status' == 'Operational'. For owners/developers/end users read https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2024-09/opprjslmopdata-aggregated.xlsx, same sheet, and join on 'Landfill ID'.
example.example_result: 123 rows, 120 Project IDs, 110 landfills (112 rows Pipeline Injection, 11 Local Use). Example: City of Fort Smith Landfill, AR, 35.2926,-94.3704, Project ID 180840-0, Pipeline Injection, LFG flow 2.184 mmscfd; aggregated file: developers Cambrian Energy; Morrow Renewables, LLC; end users Anew Climate, LLC; Summit Utilities, Inc.

sources.name: AgSTAR Livestock Anaerobic Digester Database (Excel and Anaerobic Digester Map feature services)
sources.format: XLSX (sheets 'Operational and Construction' and 'Shutdown'); ArcGIS REST FeatureServer layers (JSON)
sources.summary: 400 operating livestock-farm digesters (plus 73 under construction in the Excel) with city/state, animal type, biogas end use (56 list Pipeline Gas), developers and a raw biogas estimate.
sources.coverage_note: Livestock farms only; voluntary data labelled June 2024; map coordinates approximated from city.
caveats: Biogas estimate is raw gas on 170 of 400 rows, not RNG capacity.

problems: The page and the file name disagree on date: page label June 2024, URL folder 2020-10, Last-Modified 2025-07-24.

example.example_result: Dairy Dreams Digester - pipeline injection, Casco WI, 2010, 'Electricity; Pipeline Gas', biogas null, 44.660888,-87.582173; Deer Run Dairy Digester, Kewaunee WI, 2012, 'Pipeline Gas', 231000 cu ft/day, 44.366526,-87.66454.

sources.name: Part 80: EPA Fuel Programs Registered Company/Facility ID List (facility type 'Biogas Producer')
sources.publisher: U.S. EPA, Office of Transportation and Air Quality (Fuels Registration)
sources.format: XLS (legacy Excel; converted to CSV with xls2csv for analysis)
sources.summary: 526 rows (502 facilities, 336 companies, 45 states) of registered biogas-producer facilities with company, address and D code, all sectors; updated daily.
sources.coverage_note: Registered parties only; registration is not operation; no capacity, feedstock or injection fields.
caveats: Registered is not operating (Couco Creek Digester is registered but still under construction in AgSTAR).

sources.name: LCFS Pathway Certified Carbon Intensities: Current Fuel Pathways spreadsheet
sources.summary: 315 non-retired biomethane pathways for 135 US facilities with producer, facility, feedstock and delivery-route text; certified for California credits.
sources.coverage_note: Only facilities seeking California credit; state-level location; certification is not proof of operation.
caveats: Pathway rows are not plants: group by Facility (ID).

sources.name: Argonne Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Database
sources.publisher: Argonne National Laboratory (U.S. DOE national laboratory)
sources.summary: Argonne's RNG database is described as a comprehensive US list of biogas projects upgrading to pipeline gas or vehicle fuel (updated August 2026); contents not opened.
sources.coverage_note: Blocked to automated clients by Cloudflare; fields, counts and status unknown.
caveats: Not tested: nothing about its fields or counts is verified.
Use a normal browser to download and then check operating status.

problems: Landing page and file URL return 403 with 'cf-mitigated: challenge' (Cloudflare managed challenge) to automated clients.

if_unstructured.summary: No permit or registry document was followed for this card; plant-level facts outside the structured files (injection point, commissioning) came from an operator-sourced article and a 2008 news article.

local_terms.meaning: EPA landfill and landfill-gas-energy project files; filter Project Type Category 'Renewable Natural Gas'.
EPA list of livestock-farm digesters; filter Biogas End Use 'Pipeline Gas'.
CARB pathway list; Fuel Category Bio-CNG or Bio-LNG shows biomethane producers by facility.
Biogas upgraded to pipeline quality; the US term for biomethane.
Digester on a farm, wastewater plant or food-waste site that produces biogas.
Biogas from municipal solid waste landfills; LMOP counts it in mmscfd.
Plant that cleans biogas to pipeline quality (for example 'Milam High Btu Gas Plant' in CARB).

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
